detaileddescription.para: Apply Local Update.

If this is not the first node, invoke WaitForPreviousFunc to block until the preceding node completes.
Apply the update via HotReloadEngine::applyHotReload.
Invoke SignalReadyFunc to unblock the next node.
On failure, optionally rollback via HotReloadEngine::rollback.

briefdescription.para: Manages the coordinated, replication-safe update of a single node within a multi-node ThemisDB cluster.

detaileddescription.para: Each node in the cluster runs its own CoordinatedUpdateManager instance. Nodes update in a deterministic, ascending sequence so that replicas are always updated before the replication leader, preventing version skew.

Inter-node synchronisation is injected via two callbacks:
WaitForPreviousFunc: blocks until the preceding node signals readiness.
SignalReadyFunc: notifies the next node that this node has completed.
This design keeps the class transport-agnostic and easy to unit-test.
